landing.pillars_subtitle: Sharegy combines high-tech home energy management with decentralized local energy sharing in the neighbourhood.
landing.p1_f1_desc: Real-time dynamic adjustment of EV wallbox and heating elements. Your car charges solely with sunshine from your roof – without expensive grid power.
landing.p1_f2_desc: Integration of dynamic exchange prices (EPEX Spot / Awattar / Tibber). Home storage charges automatically during price lows and cushions peak rates.

landing.p1_f3_desc: Regulatory dimming for EV chargers and heat pumps. Sharegy guarantees grid-compliant dimming to 4.2 kW and secures your annual lump-sum rebate.
landing.p2_f1_desc: Don't sell excess solar for pennies: Share your solar power directly with neighbours, tenants or family in the same community at fair rates.

landing.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Sharegy, cloud control and energy sharing.
landing.faq_1_q: Do I need an expensive extra hardware box in the meter cabinet?
landing.faq_1_a: No! Sharegy is 100% cloud and protocol based. We connect directly via standard interfaces of your existing equipment (Modbus TCP, OCPP 1.6 / 2.0.1 / 2.1, SunSpec, Cloud APIs). You save €800 to €1,500 in proprietary hardware and installation fees.
landing.faq_2_q: How does the § 14a grid fee reduction work?
landing.faq_2_a: Sharegy complies with all regulations for controllable loads (wallboxes, heat pumps, battery storage). Through grid-compliant dimming, you secure annual lump-sum rebates (Module 1: approx. €160 to €190/year) or reduced grid fees (Module 2).
landing.faq_3_q: What is the difference between Pillar 1 (Smart EMS) and Pillar 2 (Energy Sharing)?
landing.faq_3_a: Pillar 1 optimizes your own home system (solar surplus into EV and storage, dynamic prices, § 14a rebates). Pillar 2 connects you with neighbours and tenants: When your storage is full, share surplus solar locally at fair prices instead of feeding in for minimal feed-in tariffs.
landing.faq_4_q: Are all manufacturer brand names protected?
landing.faq_4_a: Yes. All mentioned trademarks and brand names belong to their respective owners. Their mention serves solely to describe technical compatibility under applicable trademark law.
landing.faq_5_q: How can I try the live demo?
landing.faq_5_a: Simply click 'Launch Live Demo' at the top or use the interactive simulator on this page. You can instantly test all control modes and scenarios – no registration needed.

vpp_cockpit.glossary_vpp_desc: Individual home batteries are too small for the wholesale power market. Sharegy aggregates 50 or 500 storage systems digitally into a large 'virtual battery asset' that provides grid support during peak demand.
